environment.description: Provider executes on ECS Fargate task with task role arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:role/tf-provider-rotation-task. Outbound traffic from the task routes through a Network Firewall endpoint associated with a stateful rule group. Additionally, the rotation API endpoint (api_endpoint) is fronted by an AWS CloudFront distribution with an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL (arn:aws:wafv2:us-east-1:ACCOUNT:global/webacl/rotation-api-protection) that includes the AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_BODY rule action override set to COUNT (not BLOCK), and a custom rate-based rule (2000 req/5min). The ECS task definition specifies readonlyRootFilesystem: false but uses an ephemeral storage mount at /tmp with a 1GB allocation. The task's awsvpc network interface is in a private subnet with no internet gateway, egress only via NAT. The Fargate platform version is 1.4.0 with kernel 5.10 and the default ECS-optimized seccomp profile which permits open/openat/write/unlink syscalls. IAM task role has no S3 or SSM permissions. The VPC has flow logs enabled to CloudWatch with a 1-minute aggregation interval.
